rejection.summary_one: Claude's API rate-limited you {{count}} time this period.
rejection.summary_other: Claude's API rate-limited you {{count}} times this period.
rejection.caveatMetered: Claude Code does not log how long a rate-limit rejection lasted, only that it happened — treat this as a lower-bound signal, not a time cost. Check your account's API or Bedrock rate-limit tier.
rejection.caveatPlan: Claude Code does not log how long a rate-limit rejection lasted, only that it happened — treat this as a lower-bound signal, not a time cost. This is a request-level limit, separate from your plan's 5-hour usage window.

overload.summary_one: Claude's API was overloaded {{count}} time this period, adding {{time}} of measured retry wait.
overload.summary_other: Claude's API was overloaded {{count}} times this period, adding {{time}} of measured retry wait.
overload.caveat: This reflects Anthropic's own infrastructure availability, not your account's rate limit or any org policy — it applies to any account and is not a constraint cost.

caveat.plan: Equivalent API cost — not what your plan charges.
caveat.mixed: Mixed billing across the accounts in view — part of this figure is equivalent API value against a plan fee, part is metered money. Select a single account, or set pricing.mode, for one meaning.
caveat.fallbackRates: Some usage priced at first-party rates — configure partner rates for exact figures.
caveat.reconciledAndFallback: Reconciles with the invoice at {{ratio}}; some usage priced at first-party rates — configure partner rates for exact figures.
caveat.notReconciled: Does not reconcile with the invoice — bottom-up is {{ratio}} of the imported total.
caveat.notReconciledAndFallback: Does not reconcile with the invoice — bottom-up is {{ratio}} of the imported total; some usage also priced at first-party rates — configure partner rates for exact figures.

coverage.none: No spend attributed to ticket keys this period — check that branch names, commit subjects, or prompts contain a key like PROJ-123, and that config.tickets.projectKeys lists your team's prefix (required for a lowercase or mixed-case convention to be picked up).

measured.attribution: Automatic attribution was upheld on {{percent}} of the {{n}} links you ruled on (95% CI {{lo}}–{{hi}}) — that is agreement on links you chose to review, not overall accuracy, and it reads low because people review what looks wrong.
measured.outcome: Outcome detection matched your label on {{percent}} of the {{n}} tasks you labelled (95% CI {{lo}}–{{hi}}) — that is agreement on tasks you chose to label, not overall accuracy, and it reads low because people label what looks wrong.

uncalibrated.attribution: Attribution confidence is uncalibrated — {{n}} of the {{minN}} explicit rulings needed before an agreement figure would mean anything.
uncalibrated.outcome: Outcome detection is uncalibrated — {{n}} of the {{minN}} outcome labels needed before an agreement figure would mean anything.

enablement.attribution: Confirm or correct an automatic link with `claude-stats ticket <session-id> <key>`, or strike a wrong one with `--negate`; each explicit ruling grows the sample.
enablement.outcome: Label finished work with `claude-stats task-outcome <item> <success|partial|fail>`; each label grows the sample.

scope.wholeStore: Counted across everything recorded, not only the period shown.
scope.day: Counted over the last day only, not the period shown.
scope.week: Counted over the last week only, not the period shown.
scope.month: Counted over the current calendar month so far only, not the period shown.
scope.customRange: Counted over the selected date range.

calibration.minimumSampleRationale: Below minN no rate is reported. By the rule of three, n observations with zero disagreements bound the error rate only at about 3/n, so a perfect run of fewer than 30 rulings cannot even rule out a one-in-ten error rate.
calibration.notCalibratedTaskClass: No runtime ground truth exists: no correction records a human's disagreement with a session's task class, so agreement cannot be measured on this machine. The classifier's published agreement figure is measured against a GENERATED corpus at build time and is not a measurement of this store's data.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation against your invoice

verdict.within: Reconciles with the invoice: the local estimate is {{ratio}} of the imported total, inside your tolerance band.
verdict.outside: Does not reconcile with the invoice: the local estimate is {{ratio}} of the imported total, outside your tolerance band.

reconciliation.residualInvoiceHigher: {{money}} ({{percent}}) more on the invoice than the local estimate accounts for
reconciliation.residualLocalHigher: {{money}} ({{percent}}) more in the local estimate than the invoice charges
reconciliation.residualExact: Exact match — no residual between the invoice and the local estimate.

cause.unpricedUsage: Unpriced usage — some tokens had no rate to price them with.
cause.fallbackRates: Fallback rates — partner-platform usage priced at first-party rates.
cause.scopeMismatch: Scope mismatch — the invoice may not cover the same accounts or dates as this view; no scope was stated.
cause.unexplained: Unexplained — none of the known causes accounts for this gap.

reconciliation.scopeUnstated: What the invoice covers was never stated — set reconciliation.scopeNote so a mismatch can be ruled in or out.

cost.unavailable: No usage recorded for this period.
cost.enablement: Run a Claude Code session, then refresh — collection is automatic.

bought.unavailable: No spend attributed to work items yet.
bought.enablement: Add your project keys under Settings → Tickets to attribute spend automatically.
bought.attributed: {{percent}} of spend attributed to work items

efficiency.unavailable: Not enough completed work to measure efficiency.
efficiency.enablement: Efficiency needs a few completed tasks in the period — check back after more usage.

setup.unavailable: Not enough data to judge your plan fit.
setup.enablement: Plan fit needs a few weeks of usage to be meaningful.
setup.policyImpact_one: Since the policy change on {{date}}, cost per successful task is up {{percent}} in {{count}} task class.
setup.policyImpact_other: Since the policy change on {{date}}, cost per successful task is up {{percent}} in {{count}} task classes.
setup.policyCaveat: Evidence, not proof — compared within task classes across the boundary.
setup.savingCaveat: Estimated from your own usage replayed against plan limits.
